title: Viral Picnic Faces Big Bill: casual invite draws 500 RSVPs; permits may cost $4,000
summary_full: What began as a casual picnic invitation in San Francisco has blossomed into a sprawling celebration attracting hundreds. The surge in interest led to the need for permits and enhanced safety measures, resulting in hefty costs for the organizer. Fortunately, Partiful has stepped in to cover these expenses, turning the picnic into a vibrant friendship festival for all attendees.
